name: the-hive
description: The Hive plugin controls a sleeping Agentinnen fleet through the data-sparse the-hive-mcp server. Masterjet remains a separately named component.

interface.shortDescription: Control isolated Agentinnen with The Hive local MCP.
interface.longDescription: Adds the-hive-mcp plus fleet-management skills and an App Bridge manifest for starting, assigning, auditing, and safely inspecting a scalable sleeping Agentinnen fleet. Masterjet remains a separately named component; the tool surface is data-sparse by default.
defaultPrompt: Use The Hive to start Agentin A1 and Agentin B1
Assign a read-only Exploriererin task with the-hive-mcp
Check the-hive App Bridge and MCP status
